user: Small product teams preparing a public launch
problem: The official launch date hides uncertainty that individual team members can see.
alternative: Status meetings, spreadsheets and informal messages
why_prediction: Collect explicit forecasts and compare them with later outcomes instead of a vague green status.
why_solana: Future shared forecast registry for independently verifiable timestamps and outcomes; not implemented in this prototype.
difference: A resolution-first launch forecast with a visible audit trail, rather than another public betting exchange.
market_question: Will our team publish the public demo by 18:00 UTC on 8 October 2026?
resolution_rule: YES only if the named release page shows a usable public demo published on or before the stated deadline. The production version must verify an archived source and its timestamp.
void_policy: VOID if the release page cannot be verified, the scope changes, or the evidence conflicts. No financial settlement.
